description: Per-member minecraft characters for plural systems playing in the same minecraft world.

releases.notes:
New in this release:
[v1.2]
- Per-alter stats, advancements, attributes, status effects, vehicles, ender pearls, pets, trial chamber vaults
- Shoulder parrots are correctly saved to an alter when switching off
- Sync system between singleplayer and multiplayer
- Import system from PluralKit
- Polymer support - if the mod is loaded alongside Polymer-core on a server, all the custom textures will be included by default
- Lots of new alter icons
- Health/Hunger display in Alter Details screen
- Tons of other bugfixes (see git history if you're curious :p)

[v1.2.1]
- Fixed bug where icons are not being saved/written properly
- Mod icon!

Includes most of the new mod functionality:

- Per-alter stats, advancements, attributes, vehicles
- Sync system between singleplayer and multiplayer
- Import system from PluralKit
- Polymer support - if the mod is loaded alongside Polymer-core on a server, all the custom textures will be included by default
- some other small bugfixes

- Fix keep inventory not being persisted per alter
- Fix file reading issues
- Refactor server-side GUI to have less duplicate code
- Add custom GUI icons and Alter icons (thank you snuffy)
- Make mod compatible with 26.2
- Add README
Basic mod functionaliy + some QOL fixes
